description.text: The third expansion pack of the Pokémon Card e series, released in Japan on 24 May 2002. It is set around undersea ruins at the southern tip of the mysterious continent, and it brought new kinds of cards, among them three Special Energy said to sleep in those ruins. Three secret cards numbered past the printed total, Nidoking, Kingdra and Lugia, have the new Crystal Type Poké-Body: when a basic Energy card is attached to one from the hand, the Pokémon takes that Energy's type until the end of the turn. With The Town on No Map it became the English Aquapolis in January 2003.
